julia.sales: Quick ask from MapleBank POC — must keep all request payloads + logs in Canada. Can we pin tenant to ca-central1 and support BYOK? Need a short answer for their 9am call.
julia.sales: TL;DR please.

noah.se: Short answers: yes we can pin; BYOK supported in region with setup. Two options: soft-affinity (fast) or hard-reserved pool (guarantee).

ben.infra: Extra short: soft-affinity = ~24-48h config, still may export aggregated metrics to us-east. hard-reserved pool = ~1-2 weeks provisioning + capacity commit; keeps payloads, logs, KMS in CA if we enable regional control-plane.

emma.legal: We can issue a CA sub-processor attestation only for hard-reserved or private deployments. Soft-affinity gets a technical configuration note but not a legal guarantee.

noah.se: Pricing snapshot: soft = no change (small ops fee $500). hard-reserved POC uplift ~30-45% + one-time BYOK integration ($8k-$15k) depending on KMS vendor. Private = enterprise quote.

ben.infra: Minimal routing snippet we can apply for the POC:
route_policy: prefer_region=ca-central1; pin_mode=hard; failover=none; kms=customer_managed
(note: failover=none returns errors if reserved pool exhausted).

julia.sales: Perfect. I'll propose soft-affinity today for POC start and say hard-reserved if they need legal guarantee. Action items: @noah.se send pricing estimate, @emma.legal draft attestation template, @ben.infra confirm telemetry endpoints to block.

infra-bot: Reminder set for meeting (will ping 30m prior).
